name: GitLab Fleet Governor
tagline: Declarative Policy-as-Code & Fleet Governance Automation Engine
description: Production-grade governance engine written in Go that treats GitLab organization governance as version-controlled code. Features 10 reconcilers for push rules, protected branches, approval matrices, pipeline retention, and compliance frameworks across enterprise fleets.
features: Declarative YAML/JSON policy-as-code with environment variable substitution
Recursive Breadth-First Search (BFS) group hierarchy traversal and project filtering
Dry-run simulation mode computing exact attribute-level drift before mutation
Dual runtime: standalone CLI, Docker container, CI/CD pipeline, or AWS Lambda
Interactive Live Studio for visual policy validation and YAML generation
architectureDetails: Bounded worker pool, token-bucket rate limiter, keyset streaming pagination, and native EventBridge/S3 Lambda triggers.

name: OwlFlow
tagline: Event-Driven Workflow Automation Engine & Visual DAG Studio
description: A lightweight, high-performance workflow automation engine written in Go. Features event-driven webhooks, cron scheduling, and an interactive DAG studio for orchestrating complex developer and cloud automation tasks.
features: Lightweight, compiled Go binary with sub-millisecond execution overhead
Interactive visual DAG studio for declarative workflow composition
Event-driven webhook listeners and high-precision cron schedulers
Resilient step retry policies and distributed state persistence
architectureDetails: Engineered in Go with concurrent worker pools, zero-alloc state machines, and embedded SQLite/DuckDB workflow execution logs.

name: OTel AWS Log Processor
tagline: High-Throughput OpenTelemetry Access Log Processor for AWS Services
description: A high-performance Go-based AWS Lambda tool and stream processor that converts AWS access logs (ALB, NLB, WAF, CloudFront, and VPC Flow) into standardized OpenTelemetry (OTLP) records at line rate.
features: Zero-allocation SIMD string parsing for ALB, NLB, WAF, and CloudFront logs
Direct conversion to OpenTelemetry Proto (OTLP) schemas
Deployable as high-scale S3/EventBridge triggered AWS Lambda
Streaming gzip decompression with minimal heap pressure
architectureDetails: Go binary leveraging reusable buffer pools and optimized string scanners to parse logs with microsecond execution times.

name: Jules AI Agents
tagline: Specialized Autonomous Code Review & Refactoring Agent Swarm
description: Suite of specialized Go agents powered by LocalHarness. Features Bolt (Performance optimization), Palette (Design & UX), and Sentinel (Security auditing) to autonomously analyze codebases, implement fixes on descriptive branches, and prepare pull requests.
features: Bolt Agent: Autonomous profiling, memory bottleneck detection, and algorithmic optimization
Sentinel Agent: Security audit, secret detection, and vulnerability remediation
Palette Agent: Design system alignment and frontend component UX refactoring
Runs natively via Go or inside isolated Docker workspaces
architectureDetails: Go agent architecture powered by github.com/divmora/localharness with automated Git branching and PR preparation.

name: Code Reviewer AI Agent
tagline: Context-Aware AI Code Review CLI for GitLab, GitHub & Bitbucket
description: Production-grade AI code review CLI built in Go and powered by LocalHarness. Analyzes PRs and diffs across GitLab (cloud & self-hosted), GitHub, and Bitbucket with AST scope slicing, quality scorecards, and 1-click committable suggestions.
features: Context-aware AST scope slicing extracting enclosing functions and classes
Strict anti-hallucination bounds limiting comments to modified diff lines
Automatic MR description updates with Quality, Security, and Maintainability scorecards
Self-hosted GitLab support with custom domains and internal SSL verification skip
architectureDetails: Go binary with exponential backoff stale diff handlers, comment budgeting, secret scanning, and scoped score labeling.

name: AWS DAS Processor
tagline: Automated Ingestion, Decryption & Filtration Engine for AWS Database Activity Streams
description: High-performance AWS Lambda stream processor written in Go. Consumes Amazon Aurora and RDS Database Activity Streams (DAS) via S3/SQS fanout, performs in-line KMS envelope decryption, zlib decompression, and streams filtered audit records back to S3.
features: Automated Database Activity Streams consumption via S3/SQS event architecture
In-line cryptographic envelope decryption of sensitive SQL activity using AWS KMS
Normalized schema output and zlib payload decompression with minimal heap overhead
Configurable SQL statement filtering, user excludes, and CloudWatch metrics
architectureDetails: Go Lambda binary utilizing AWS SDK v2, concurrency-bounded workers, and least-privilege IAM policies.

name: Cloudflare SMTP Relay
tagline: Modular SMTP Server Relaying via Cloudflare Email Routing API
description: A robust, modular Node.js SMTP relay server designed to accept standard SMTP connections from legacy appliances, printers, and scripts, forwarding emails securely via Cloudflare Email Routing REST API.
features: Standard SMTP server compatible with legacy appliances, servers, and scripts
Secure TLS negotiation and IP whitelist filtering
Reliable HTTP REST dispatch to Cloudflare Email API with retry backoff
Single-command Docker container deployment
architectureDetails: Built on modular Node.js streams with connection pooling and REST client failover.

name: Functionless URL Shortener
tagline: Zero-Compute High-Performance Cloud URL Redirection Architecture
description: Architectural blueprint and Terraform/CloudFormation IaC for high-scale URL shortening that eliminates compute layers using native cloud CDN routing and edge key-value storage.
features: Zero compute container or Lambda execution on the redirection path
Direct CloudFront / Edge key-value redirection mapping
Sub-10ms global edge redirection response times
Fully automated Infrastructure as Code provisioning
architectureDetails: Leverages edge cache rewrites and object metadata headers to bypass compute execution.

name: Show & Tell
tagline: Interactive Architecture & Demo Presentation Platform for Engineering Teams
description: A developer-focused presentation and interactive demo tool designed for engineering teams to share architecture decisions, live code walkthroughs, and system demos effortlessly.
features: Markdown-first slide decks with live interactive code blocks and diagram rendering
Built-in syntax highlighting and side-by-side architecture diffs
Zero configuration export to static HTML for GitHub Pages sharing
Presenter mode with presenter notes and timer support
architectureDetails: Engineered with Vite and React, rendering AST-parsed Markdown slides with dynamic client-side evaluation.

name: LocalHarness
tagline: High-Performance Agent Runtime Engine & Interactive TUI (lhctl)
description: A Go binary engine that executes complete agentic loops: receives prompts via WebSocket, dispatches tools (file I/O, search, shell, Playwright browser), indexes AST codegraphs in DuckDB, and streams structured events to clients. Includes the lhctl terminal interface.
features: Pipe-based handshake (stdin/stdout) and Protobuf wire protocol
Interactive TUI (lhctl) with real-time streaming, diff approvals, and YOLO mode
DuckDB AST-level code graph search and blast radius analyzer
Dual execution: ephemeral subprocess or persistent background daemon
architectureDetails: Engineered in Go with WebSocket Protobuf transport, resilient backoff retry, and Playwright browser integration.
